scope: Portugal medical discovery — University of Porto Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: A 2024 official Diário da República order records a favourable A3ES decision and approved curricular restructuring for the University of Porto integrated study cycle leading to the Master's degree in Medicine through the Faculty of Medicine.
An official 2025 regulation governs specific recognition procedures for the Portuguese Integrated Master's in Medicine at the Faculty of Medicine University of Porto.
FMUP's official portal includes programme registration and A3ES accreditation references.

A complete clinical-placement, accommodation and international student-support packet was not completed.
